BiblicalUsage: Bul is the eighth month of the Hebrew year, the month in which Solomon's temple was finished in the eleventh year of his reign. The name marks the completion of the house, finished throughout all its parts.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God finishes what He starts, and Bul is the month that says so: the house was done, down to the last detail.
